narrative.overview: BillSlice should feel like a capable friend helping at a busy restaurant table: quick to understand, calm under imperfect receipt data, and trustworthy with the final numbers. The light, warm canvas remains quiet while emerald marks the next action, selected state, successful result, and AI-assisted moments. Familiar Android patterns and direct language keep the product usable without instruction. The system is task-first rather than promotional. Every screen has one clear job, manual entry remains as visible and credible as Smart Scan, and AI output is always presented as an editable draft.
keyCharacteristics: Warm light surfaces built for use under mixed restaurant lighting.
Bright emerald actions balanced by deep charcoal and green-tinted neutrals.
Rounded, confident controls with compact repeated rows.
One focused task and one dominant action per screen.
Transparent loading, warning, disabled, empty, and success states.

rules.name: The Emerald Means Action Rule
rules.body: Use #20C982 for primary actions, progress, selected states, and success. Do not scatter it across inactive decoration.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Use #FAF9F6, #FFFEFC, and #17211D instead of pure white or black.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Funnel Sans across product UI, labels, and numeric data. Do not introduce a display serif, script, or monospaced font.

rules.name: The Numbers Stay Legible Rule
rules.body: Never sacrifice currency clarity for style. Keep person totals right-aligned where rows compare values, and use Indonesian grouping punctuation by default.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Rows, fields, banners, and ordinary cards use color and a 1dp border, not shadows. Never stack shadows on nested containers.

dos: Do keep each screen focused on one task and one dominant action.
Do keep manual entry visible anywhere Smart Scan can fail or be skipped.
Do label AI parsing as an editable draft and require confirmation before splitting.
Do format currency as IDR by default, such as Rp40.000 and Rp219.450.
Do keep ads outside the active split flow.
donts: Don't use the starter Material purple palette.
Don't use pure black or white as primary surfaces or text.
Don't clutter screens, use heavy gradients, glassmorphism, decorative finance-dashboard styling, or marketing-only hero pages.
Don't hide manual entry behind an error state or overflow menu.
Don't present AI output as final or silently correct receipt totals.
